name: zinput_play_alt_fire_effect
description: zInputDI::PlayAltFireEffect clamps alt-fire force-feedback gain, applies the DirectInput DIEP_GAIN parameter, and starts the alt-fire effect once.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL inspection in the current session verified the fastcall effect-set receiver, stack float gain argument, null AltFire early return, zeroed 0x34-byte DIEFFECT-shaped gain descriptor, Stop call, gain clamp to [0.25, 1.0], dwSize 0x34, dwGain as gain * 10000, SetParameters with flag 4 (DIEP_GAIN), and Start with one iteration and zero flags.
The native smoke verifies the null-alt no-op path, stop/set-parameters/start side effects, max gain clamp to 10000, and min gain clamp to 2500.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x42fac0 yet; tier S verification is deferred to the zInput/provider ABI pass.
